title: Backlog check catches touches that name a moved file
goal: backlog.py check reports an error when an open item's touches names a plain path that git history had and HEAD no longer has, and backlog.py selectors prints every tests.py -k selector of open items with the number of tests it collects now, so a file move that strands an item's scope or proof is visible before the item is worked
notes: Selectors in item checks are an interface a refactor can strand. Zero collected tests already fails a check (pytest exits 5), so the risk is scope, not false proof: many open items name _tools/test_querylog.py or _tools/test_kb.py in touches, and done refuses a commit outside touches. Most -k selectors in item checks name tests their items have yet to write, so selectors reports counts and never fails on zero.
